details:
Description: I propose an enhancement to the VRC+ Camera Drone feature: a "Geofence Roaming Mode" that allows users to define a 3D geofenced area by selecting two coordinates (opposite corners of a box) within a VRChat world. The drone would autonomously roam within this geofenced box, flying random paths, circling nearby players, and capturing dynamic footage of activities inside the defined area.

Key Features:

Geofence Setup: Users select two points in the world (e.g., via controller or UI) to define a 3D rectangular prism. The drone restricts its movement to this volume.

Random Path Generation: The drone flies smooth, randomized paths within the geofence, avoiding collisions with world geometry and other players.

Player-Circling Behavior: When a player is detected within the geofence, the drone can orbit them at a configurable distance and speed, capturing cinematic angles before resuming random paths.

Dynamic Capture: The drone records or streams footage, focusing on players and events within the geofence, with options to adjust focus priority (e.g., prioritize specific players).

UI Integration: Add a geofence setup option in the Camera Drone’s Quick Menu interface, with sliders for path randomness, circling radius, and flight speed.

Udon Support: Expose geofence coordinates and drone behavior settings to Udon, allowing world creators to predefine geofenced areas or customize drone interactions.

Use Cases:

Event Coverage: Automatically capture dynamic footage of social gatherings, performances, or competitions within a specific area without manual drone piloting.

Cinematic Content Creation: Enable creators to record immersive videos with minimal effort, focusing on players and activities in a defined space.

World Exploration: Allow users to set a geofence in scenic worlds and let the drone explore autonomously, capturing unique perspectives.

Why This Matters: The current Camera Drone requires manual control or predefined paths, which can be limiting for capturing spontaneous moments or covering large or regular events. A geofence-based roaming mode would make the drone more autonomous and versatile, enhancing its utility for VRC+ subscribers and content creators. It would also align with VRChat’s focus on creative tools, providing a hands-free way to document experiences.

Additional Notes:

Ensure the drone respects world colliders and player personal space to avoid griefing concerns.

Consider a toggle to enable/disable player-circling for privacy.

As a VRC+ exclusive feature it can add value to the subscription.

I believe this feature would elevate the Camera Drone’s functionality for storytelling and content creation. Thank you for considering this request!
title: Camera Drone Geofence Mode with Random Paths and Player-Circling
